# =====================================================
# Sample Weather Events for Validation. Processing Script
# Functionality: Florencia Sangermano
# Development: The functionality of this script was designed by the author with code generated through instructions provided to Copilot AI.
# =====================================================
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import shutil


# Load your CSV
df = pd.read_csv("D:\Flor\SaudiArabia\YamnetResults\weather_labels_summaryWithConfidence.csv")

# -----------------------------
# 1. SAMPLE 100 FILES WITH NO WEATHER
# -----------------------------
none_group = df[(df['WeatherClasses'] == 'NONE') & (df['WeatherPercent'] == 0)]
none_sample = none_group.sample(n=100, random_state=42)

# -----------------------------
# 2. SAMPLE 100 FILES WITH WEATHER
#    STRATIFIED ACROSS MAX CONFIDENCE
# -----------------------------
weather_group = df[df['WeatherClasses'] != 'NONE'].copy()

# Compute MaxConfidence from WeatherConfidenceList
def extract_max_conf(conf_list):
    if pd.isna(conf_list) or conf_list.strip() == "":
        return 0.0
    return max(float(x) for x in conf_list.split(","))

weather_group['MaxConfidence'] = weather_group['WeatherConfidenceList'].apply(extract_max_conf)

# Create 10 equal-width bins across the range of MaxConfidence
weather_group['bin'] = pd.cut(weather_group['MaxConfidence'], bins=10)

# Sample 100 total → 10 bins × 10 samples per bin
weather_sample = (
    weather_group
    .groupby('bin', group_keys=False)
    .apply(lambda x: x.sample(n=10, random_state=42))
)


# -----------------------------
# 3. COMBINE THE TWO SAMPLES
# -----------------------------
final_sample = pd.concat([none_sample, weather_sample], ignore_index=True)

# Save to CSV
final_sample.to_csv(r"D:\Flor\SaudiArabia\YamnetResults\sampled_files_Final.csv", index=False)

# -----------------------------
# 4. COPY FILES TO NEW FOLDER
# -----------------------------

# Folder where files will be copied
output_folder = r"D:\Flor\SaudiArabia\YamnetResults\forvalidation_Final"

# Create folder if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)

# Loop through each file in the Filename column and copy it
for filepath in final_sample['Filename']:
    if os.path.isfile(filepath):  # ensure file exists
        shutil.copy(filepath, output_folder)
    else:
        print(f"WARNING: File not found → {filepath}")
        
# -----------------------------
## -----------------------------
# 5. GENERATE HTML VALIDATION PAGE
# -----------------------------

# html output file
html_file = r"D:\Flor\SaudiArabia\YamnetResults\validation_page_final.html"

weather_classes = [
    "NONE",
    "Rain",
    "Rain on surface",
    "Raindrop",
    "Wind",
    "Wind noise (microphone)"
]

# Build dropdown HTML
dropdown_html = "".join([f'<option value="{w}">{w}</option>' for w in weather_classes])

rows = []
for _, row in final_sample.iterrows():
    filename = row['Filename']
    display_name = os.path.basename(filename)
    weather_class = row['WeatherClasses']
    weather_percent = row['WeatherPercent']

    # Convert Windows path to browser-friendly path
    link = filename.replace("\\", "/")

    rows.append(f"""
        <tr>
            <td data-weather="{weather_class}" data-percent="{weather_percent}">
                {display_name}
            </td>
            <td>
                <select>
                    {dropdown_html}
                </select>
            </td>
            <td>
                <button onclick="openAudacity('{link}')">Open in Audacity</button>
            </td>
            <td>
                <input type="text" placeholder="Write notes here..." style="width:180px;">
            </td>
        </tr>
    """)


# Full HTML document with CSV export + Audacity hook
html_content = f"""
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Weather Validation Sheet</title>
    <style>
        body {{
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            margin: 20px;
        }}
        table {{
            border-collapse: collapse;
            width: 100%;
        }}
        th, td {{
            border: 1px solid #ccc;
            padding: 8px;
        }}
        th {{
            background-color: #f2f2f2;
        }}
        select {{
            width: 180px;
        }}
        input[type='text'] {{
            width: 180px;
        }}
        button {{
            margin-top: 10px;
            padding: 6px 12px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <h2>YAMNet Weather Validation Sheet</h2>
    <p>Listen, label, write notes, and export your validation results.</p>
    <p>Please cite the use of this as: Sangermano, F. (2026). YAMNet Weather Validation Interface for Soundscape Analysis. GitHub Repository. https://github.com/flosanger/WeatherEvents/ .</p>

    <table>
        <tr>
            <th>Filename</th>
            <th>Validation Class</th>
            <th>External Tool</th>
            <th>Notes</th>
        </tr>
        {''.join(rows)}
    </table>

    <button onclick="downloadCSV()">Download Validation CSV</button>
    <button onclick="saveHTML()">Save HTML with Edits</button>

    <script>
    function openAudacity(filepath) {{
        fetch("http://localhost:5001/open?file=" + encodeURIComponent(filepath));
    }}

    function downloadCSV() {{
        let rows = [];
        rows.push(["Filename", "WeatherClass", "WeatherPercent", "ValidationClass", "Notes"]);

        const table = document.querySelector("table");
        const trs = table.querySelectorAll("tr");

        for (let i = 1; i < trs.length; i++) {{
            const tds = trs[i].querySelectorAll("td");

            const filename = tds[0].innerText.trim();
            const weatherClass = tds[0].getAttribute("data-weather");
            const weatherPercent = tds[0].getAttribute("data-percent");
            const validationClass = tds[1].querySelector("select").value;
            const notes = tds[3].querySelector("input").value;

            rows.push([filename, weatherClass, weatherPercent, validationClass, notes]);
        }}

        let csvContent = "";
        rows.forEach(row => {{
            csvContent += row.join(",") + "\\n";
        }});

        const blob = new Blob([csvContent], {{ type: "text/csv" }});
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = "D:/Flor/SaudiArabia/YamnetResults/validation_resultsFinal.csv";
        a.click();

        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }}

    function saveHTML() {{
        let cloned = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);

        const originalRows = document.querySelectorAll("tr");
        const clonedRows = cloned.querySelectorAll("tr");

        for (let i = 1; i < originalRows.length; i++) {{
            const origTds = originalRows[i].querySelectorAll("td");
            const cloneTds = clonedRows[i].querySelectorAll("td");

            const validationClass = origTds[1].querySelector("select").value;
            cloneTds[1].querySelector("select").value = validationClass;

            const notes = origTds[3].querySelector("input").value;
            cloneTds[3].querySelector("input").value = notes;
        }}

        const htmlString = "<!DOCTYPE html>\\n" + cloned.outerHTML;
        const blob = new Blob([htmlString], {{ type: "text/html" }});
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = "D:/Flor/SaudiArabia/YamnetResults/validation_page_with_editsFinal.html";
        a.click();

        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }}
    </script>

</body>
</html>
"""



with open(html_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(html_content)

print(f"HTML validation file created: {html_file}")
